summary: Iran has launched direct ballistic missile attacks against US bases in Saudi Arabia and Jordan, marking the first direct strike on Saudi Arabia in nearly four months. Concurrently, US forces are conducting intensive strikes against Iranian military infrastructure, including radar and logistics sites, while deploying aerial refueling aircraft to support operations. Regional tensions are escalating with reports of missile launches from Iran toward Kuwait and sightings of drones over Bahrain.
key_points: Iran launched a ballistic missile at a US base in Saudi Arabia, the first direct attack on the country in nearly four months (Source: @N12chat).
US forces are conducting intensive strikes against Iranian military targets, including radar, logistics, and missile launch sites (Source: @New_security8200).
The US is expected to deploy 10 aerial refueling aircraft to Israel within the coming day to support long-range operations (Source: @inon_yttach).
Iranian missiles were reported targeting Kuwait, resulting in reports of explosions and sirens (Source: @New_security8200).
A Hamas commander responsible for hostage release ceremonies and serving as a key figure for Mohammed Deif was killed in Khan Younis (Source: @inon_yttach).
Sirens were activated in Bahrain following reports of a Shahed-136 drone in the sky (Source: @shin_persian).
Three people were killed in an attack on a bridge in Hormozgan (Source: @lelotsenzura/93698).
US military strikes in Iran have reportedly wounded several American soldiers in Jordan (Source: @rodast_omiddana/76729).

sections.executive_summary: Iran has conducted direct ballistic missile strikes against US bases in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. The regional situation is escalating with increased aerial activity and missile launches toward Gulf states.

sections.threat_assessment: The threat level is escalating due to Iran's shift toward direct strikes against US assets in Saudi Arabia and Jordan. The deployment of US aerial refueling aircraft suggests preparations for extended-range operations. The targeting of infrastructure in Hormozgan and Kuwait indicates a broadening scope of kinetic activity.
sections.regional_response: The IRGC has warned countries hosting US forces to prepare for proportionate responses following attacks on Iranian infrastructure. Kuwait has closed its airspace and rescheduled flights in response to Iranian shelling. Bahrain has activated civil defense measures following drone sightings.
sections.intelligence_notes: The systematic destruction of Iranian military infrastructure by US forces indicates a high-intensity phase of operations. The involvement of senior Hamas figures in hostage management highlights the operational focus of IDF/Shin Bet targeting. The use of ballistic missiles against Saudi Arabia represents a significant escalation in direct state-on-state engagement.
